renders.title: Spine to track connector v2: flush track joint, track horizontal, rod to the spine (PROPOSAL: nut each side of the spine wall)
renders.comment: DRAFT, OpenPocket #561 (redrawn to the approved sketch). Only this: the real flush track joint of cad/track_joint.py, coloured as that script colours it (M8 rod through the 32 mm track pipe to the central pipe axis, ROD_OUT 50 mm; captive nut on the curved plate INSIDE the track pipe, lock nut OUTSIDE, nothing stands proud so the cart sleeve passes), with the track pipe HORIZONTAL and the spine a vertical tube. PROPOSAL (the owner's idea, not from existing drawings): a nut on each side of the spine tube wall, inside and outside, so nothing spins. No collars, no pods, no other parts. Open questions in docs/spine-connector.md. 3D model: cad/renders/spine-connector.glb. Views: -iso, -front, -top, -side.
